title: QUIC RFC 9000 PADDING and PING Focused Proof Verification
verification_method: Focused S19P1/S19P2 requirement-home tests, regenerated QUIC coverage triage, Release build, and SpecTrace JSON validation.
scope: This verification covers focused PADDING and PING frame type encoding plus PING reachability and keep-alive probe availability for the listed S19P1/S19P2 requirements.
expected_result: S19P1/S19P2 requirement-home tests prove PADDING type 0x00 and PING type 0x01 exact one-byte varint encoding, mismatched-type rejection, non-minimal varint rejection, and PING ack-eliciting probe availability.
procedure: Run the focused S19P1/S19P2 requirement-home filter.
Check the resulting diff for whitespace errors.
preconditions: Existing PADDING and PING parser/formatter behavior remains in QuicFrameCodec.
Existing ack-eliciting frame classification remains the canonical PING probe classification seam.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim a proactive PING keep-alive scheduler, unrelated S19 frame families, or packet-level close policy changes.

status_summary: Passed locally on 2026-05-04. The focused S19P1/S19P2 tail filter passed 8/8, and generated triage resolves the four targeted requirements as trace-clean.
